name: Kyonyuu Gunjin Shihai Saimin "Watashi no Ninmu wa Anata ni Gohoushi Suru Koto Desu. Ironna Ana o Gojiyuuni Otsukai Kudasai"
original_name: 巨乳軍人支配催眠「私の任務は貴方にご奉仕する事です。色んな穴をご自由にお使い下さい」
source: The protagonist is a young officer who has achieved many military successes in a short period of time, and is highly regarded by both the upper and lower ranks of the military due to his friendly personality. He is rumored to be one of the people who will support the next generation. However, these evaluations were due to the "hypnosis device" that the protagonist possessed. During a certain operation, Marcus accidentally discovers a "hypnosis device" on an enemy battleship. Without reporting it, he takes it for himself and begins to use it for his own desires. He manipulates everything to his advantage, forcing his colleagues and superiors to praise him and to have sexual relationships with women he likes. Eventually, during a transfer, Marcus was promoted to vice-captain of a new ship.
translation: 主人公是一名年轻军官，在短时间内屡立战功，又因待人亲切，深受军中上下好评，被视为有望撑起下一代的人才之一。然而，这些评价，全都源于他手中的“催眠装置”。某次作战中，马库斯偶然在敌方战舰上发现这件装置。他没有上报，而是将其据为己有，用来满足私欲。他操纵一切，让事情朝有利于自己的方向发展，迫使同僚与上司称赞他，也强迫心仪的女性与自己发生性关系。最终，在一次调动中，马库斯升任了一艘新舰的副舰长。
